items.name: Managed IT Support (Core)
items.description: Service desk and proactive maintenance for every user, during business hours.
includes: Service desk by phone, email and portal, 8am to 6pm local time, Monday to Friday
Remote support, plus on-site visits when a fix needs them
Patch management for Windows and macOS
Endpoint antivirus and health monitoring
Monthly service report and quarterly review
items.sla: Priority 1 incidents: response within 1 business hour.

items.name: Managed IT Support (Plus, 24x7)
items.description: Everything in Core, with the service desk available around the clock.
includes: Everything in Managed IT Support (Core)
24x7 service desk for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents
Named service manager

items.name: Microsoft 365 Backup
items.description: Daily backup of mailboxes, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams, kept for one year.
includes: Daily backup of Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams
One-year retention
Restores on request through the service desk

items.name: Managed Detection and Response
items.description: Endpoint detection and response, monitored by a security operations team.
includes: Endpoint detection and response agent on each device
24x7 monitoring and triage of alerts
Containment of confirmed threats, with a written incident report

items.name: Managed Network (per site)
items.description: Monitoring and management of a site's firewall, switches and wireless.
includes: Firewall, switch and wireless monitoring
Firmware updates in agreed maintenance windows
Configuration backups

items.name: Microsoft 365 Migration
items.description: Moving mailboxes and files to Microsoft 365, priced per user migrated.
includes: Discovery and migration plan
Mailbox and file migration, with cutover out of business hours
End-user guides and day-one floor support

items.name: Onboarding and Documentation
items.description: Taking over support: audit, documentation and handover from the current provider.
includes: Network and device audit
IT documentation set up in our system
Handover from the current provider
